BaseRules: One S-Rank Omniframe of the ongoing Arrival Event is guaranteed to join your team every after you research 60 times. In Target Mode where you can select a character, you will have a better chance of getting the selected S-Rank Omniframe when you get an S-Rank Omniframe.

The guarantee is inherited between the same type of pools (Calibration included). For example, after an [Arrival Construct Pool] has ended, its guarantee progress will be inherited by the next [Arrival Construct Pool].
